sources.title: LiblibAI: AI Art & Model Sharing Platform for Stable Diffusion - ToolMage
sources.snippet: LiblibAI is a leading AI creation platform and community, focusing on AI model sharing for image generation. It offers a vast library of Stable Diffusion models, including Checkpoints and LoRAs, with a special emphasis on anime, gaming, and unique Chinese artistic styles. Users can generate images online or download models for local use.
